protocol.title: High-Throughput Microfluidic Single-Cell Analysis Pipeline for Studies of Signaling Dynamics
protocol.platform: Valve-actuated multilayer PDMS microfluidic cell culture chip (continuous-flow, not DMF)
cell_lines: NIH3T3 mouse fibroblasts (p65-dsRed + H2B-GFP fluorescent fusion)
RAW264.7 mouse macrophages (p65-GFP + H2B-mCherry fluorescent fusion)
protocol.objective: Multiplexed stimulation and live-cell imaging of single cells under parallel input conditions, automated image analysis, on-chip cell retrieval, and downstream high-throughput gene expression profiling by microfluidic qPCR

device.chip_name: Cell Culture Chip (Gomez-Sjoberg et al., Anal. Chem. 2007)
device.fabrication: Multilayer soft lithography; two PDMS layers bonded and mounted on PDMS-coated glass slide
layers: Flow layer (top): contains cells and reagents; rounded cross-section channels (positive photoresist)
Control layer (bottom): creates elastomeric membrane valves; rectangular cross-section (negative photoresist)

chambers.cell_capacity: 1-1000 mammalian cells depending on cell size

valves.controller: Six manifolds x 8 valves; two-valve controller boxes via USB

mixer.notes: Combines multiple reagent inputs before delivery to selected chambers

sieve_valves.location: Entrance and exit of each chamber
sieve_valves.function: Trap cells and particles >20 um diameter

reagent_delivery.pressurization: 5% CO2 in air-gas mixture at 3-10 psi (200-700 mbar)
reagent_delivery.tubing_reagents: PTFE (0.022 in i.d. x 0.042 in o.d.)
reagent_delivery.tubing_cells: PEEK (510 um o.d. x 65 um i.d., IDEX 1543)
reagent_delivery.vial_cap: Rubber membrane screw cap; 20-gauge needle + 0.02-inch PEEK tubing

microscopy.imaging_mode: Wide-field (preferred for speed and low phototoxicity vs confocal)
microscopy.focus_system: Perfect Focus System (Nikon) recommended for large-chip multi-location imaging

pdms.mixing: Orbital mixer 3 min at 2000 rpm; defoam 5 min at 2200 rpm

surface_treatment.blocking_agent: Pluronic F-127 (Sigma P6867), 0.2% w/v in PBS
surface_treatment.ecm_protein: Fibronectin from human plasma (Millipore 341635-1MG), 100 ug/mL in PBS

cell_retrieval.lysis_buffer_composition: 250 uL resuspension buffer + 25 uL lysis enhancer (CellsDirect kit)

qpcr.master_mix: TaqMan Universal PCR Master Mix (Applied Biosystems 4304437)
qpcr.fluidigm_system: BioMark HD with IFC controller MX

steps.name: Chip surface treatment -- Pluronic blocking
steps.notes: 0.2% Pluronics F-127 in PBS flowed through non-chamber surfaces for 1 h. Blocks non-specific cell adhesion to PDMS. Air removed by flow pressure through PDMS matrix (~15 min), then Pluronic incubation continued for 1 h.

steps.name: PBS wash -- Pluronic removal
steps.notes: Pluronic must be completely washed from chip. Residual Pluronic entering chambers prevents fibronectin adhesion and downstream cell attachment. Critical step.

steps.name: Fibronectin chamber coating
steps.flow_mode: Non-chamber areas first (10 min), then chambers opened via GUI (ChIn/ChOut valves)
steps.notes: Overnight incubation (720m) used for reliable ECM coating. Fibronectin displaces PBS and air in chambers. Tested for NIH3T3 fibroblasts and RAW264.7 macrophages.

steps.name: Cell loading
steps.pressurization: 5% CO2 at 3-5 psi via PEEK tubing

loading_options.A: Automated scripted seeding with 10x phase-contrast imaging and intensity threshold detection
loading_options.B: Manual visual estimation and sequential chamber loading

steps.notes: Cells begin adhering to fibronectin within minutes. Multiple seeding rounds with 5-min waits between rounds. PEEK tubing helps prevent cell clumping.

steps.name: Cell feeding -- round 1 (t = 0 h)
steps.notes: 30% chamber volume replaced per feed round. On-chip peristaltic pump sequence. 2-h interval. Phase-contrast images acquired during feeding to monitor cell health.

steps.name: Cell feeding -- round 6 (t = 10 h)
steps.notes: 6 feeding rounds unrolled (BioScript has no loop construct). Covers ~12 h pre-stimulation growth and imaging phase.

steps.name: TNF-alpha stimulation (10-min pulse)
steps.delivery_mode: Pressure-driven full chamber flush (PTFE tubing, 5% CO2, 7 psi)
steps.notes: Stimulus timing logged for alignment with image data (critical step). Washout medium re-establishes baseline. Single representative 10-min pulse encoded; pulse trains can be added by unrolling additional stimulation cycles.

steps.name: Live-cell fluorescence imaging
steps.readout: Nuclear p65-dsRed intensity / cytoplasmic p65-dsRed intensity per cell per frame
steps.notes: liveCellImagingDetection abstracts CellProfiler nuclear segmentation, NF-kB translocation quantification, and automated cell tracking (Steps 59-66). Imaging runs as independent process from chip stimulation script.

steps.name: Cell retrieval -- trypsinization and lysis
steps.notes: Cells detach within 1-3 min post-trypsin delivery. PBS flush between chambers prevents cross-contamination. Each well sealed with tape immediately after retrieval to prevent evaporation. Lysis buffer: CellsDirect resuspension buffer + lysis enhancer (freshly prepared, kept on ice).

steps.name: One-step RT-STA reaction assembly

primer_pool.preparation: Each TaqMan assay (20x) diluted 100x in TE buffer; pool combined in 1.5 mL tube

steps.notes: 2x CellsDirect reaction mix must be fully thawed on ice and thoroughly mixed before use (critical step). Plate can be stored at -20 C for up to 3 months before adding lysate.

steps.name: RT-STA thermal cycling

thermal_protocol.step: 14 STA cycles (dominant 60 C annealing phase; 14 x 255 s)

steps.notes: 14-cycle STA modelled as single heat step at 60 C for 3570s (dominant annealing/extension phase; no loop construct in BioScript). Four sequential heat calls on rtStaReaction are valid in-place operations.

steps.name: RT-STA product dilution
steps.notes: 22 uL TE buffer added to 11 uL RT-STA product. Dilutions between 1:2 and 1:5 are acceptable. Required before Fluidigm chip loading.

steps.name: Fluidigm BioMark qPCR
steps.platform: BioMark HD with 48.48 Dynamic Array IFC
steps.export_format: Heat Map Results CSV via File > Export
steps.analysis_software: Fluidigm Real-Time PCR Analysis Software; MATLAB csvread for downstream processing

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Chip surface treatment, cell loading, feeding (6 rounds), stimulation, live imaging, cell retrieval, RT-STA, qPCR

platform_abstraction_notes: This is a valve-actuated continuous-flow PDMS chip, not a DMF/droplet electrode device. All mix steps abstract pressure-driven fluid exchange events through microchannels and chamber volumes.
heat steps model on-stage incubation under environmental control (37 C, 5% CO2, >95% humidity).
6 feeding rounds unrolled explicitly (no loop construct in BioScript); each round is mix for 1m + heat for 120m.
14 STA thermal cycles encoded as single heat at 60 C for 3570s (dominant annealing phase; no loop construct).
drain in .bs fail branch normalizes to dispose in IR -- expected compiler behavior.
bsbbif_2_t has no explicit jump to bsbbif_4_j in IR text; DOT confirms both branch edges resolve to BB4. Compiler artifact, not a bug.
